title: Cheaper browsing loops
body: Cheaper browsing loops: new compact browser and HTTP-first discovery tools help agents find links, fields, and page outlines before paying for full snapshots or raw dumps.

title: Bounded summaries by default
body: Bounded summaries by default: console, network, downloads, captures, and text reads now surface concise next actions so agents can drill in only when needed.

title: Live preview is more resilient
body: Live preview is more resilient: the dashboard falls back from screencast streaming to snapshot polling when a browser cannot provide live frames.
